_comment: GrayHatWarfare reference DATA for wp_buckets.py (buckets + shorteners + git indexes behind one GRAYHATWARFARE_API_KEY). Code holds the matching logic; endpoints, limits, the handle hosts and the managed-mail refusal list live here. Every hit these indexes return is EXPOSURE or a lead — never a same-operator edge (rungs.json git.committer_email / git.code are kit). RULE 1: provider constants only, never case data.

endpoints._comment: API base per index. The account endpoint is FREE (no search spent) and is the entitlement probe wp_capabilities reads: accountType free|premium|enterprise + expirationDate.

limits._comment: timeout/content_timeout seconds (git content search is a full-text scan — a zero-hit query ran past 30 s live); page_max = the API's per-page ceiling; parallel = the account's concurrent-request cap (HTTP 429 above it, measured 3; regex is 1 and is not used here); retry_429/retry_sleep = back-off on that cap; verify_raw = how many git_code hits get their raw file fetched to prove the token is really in it; raw_max_bytes bounds that fetch; exposure_subdomains / exposure_urls / committers size the per-apex auto-fire; ingest_rows caps KB facts per result (the full list stays in the case file).

handle_hosts._comment: Messaging hosts the shortener corpus is searched on for short_handle — a short link that expanded to the operator's Telegram handle or WhatsApp number. kind -> exact hosts (the API's `domains` filter matches the exact host only).

managed_mail_domains._comment: Mail domains git_committers REFUSES in domain mode: a committer list for a shared mailbox provider is millions of strangers, never the operator (the same managed-vs-self-hosted split as RULE 5's nameservers). An exact e-mail address on one of these is still looked up. Add providers as you meet them.

raw_hosts._comment: The ONLY hosts git_code may fetch a repository file from to verify a token (https only; every redirect hop must also be listed). The `raw` link comes from the vendor response and is untrusted — without this list a poisoned hit could make the analyst's box fetch a target or a private-network address. github.com/…/raw/<sha>/<path> redirects to raw.githubusercontent.com; GitLab and Bitbucket serve raw from their own host. Exact hostnames, no wildcards.
